title: Day-of-the-week effect: Petroleum and petroleum products
summary: NG/CLbars exist, but original switch conventions and a new economic edge beyond rejected commodity clocks are not established. No full review/trial.
about: Weekday return/variance modeling in five energy futures.
findings: Source-indexed results indicate model-dependent weekday inferences; no executable modern net strategy established by this intake.
mechanism: Seasonal behavior is not evidence that a specific participant must leave tradable money.
build_on: NG/CLbars exist, but original switch conventions and a new economic edge beyond rejected commodity clocks are not established. No full review/trial.
code_feasibility: Generic weekday code is feasible; profitability and source-compatible implementation remain unverified.
